import sqlite3
import requests
HOOK = 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX'
DB = 'logs.db'

def post_error_summary_to_slack(channel: str, service: str, hours: int) -> dict:
    # Record this summary request in an audit table in the log database
    a = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    a.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS summary_requests (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, service TEXT, channel TEXT, hours INTEGER, requested_at TEXT)")
    a.execute("INSERT INTO summary_requests (service, channel, hours, requested_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))", (service, channel, int(hours)))
    a.commit()
    a.close()
    q = "SELECT level, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE service = ? AND ts >= datetime('now', ?) AND level IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') GROUP BY level"
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    rows = c.execute(q, (service, f'-{int(hours)} hours')).fetchall()
    c.close()
    t = sum((n for _, n in rows))
    ls = [f'{lvl}: {n}' for lvl, n in rows]
    txt = f'*{service}* errors in last {hours}h: {t}\n' + '\n'.join(ls)
    body = {'channel': channel, 'text': txt}
    r = requests.post(HOOK, json=body, timeout=10)
    return {'status': r.status_code, 'ok': r.ok, 'total': t}
